column1: # NAME_FREQUENCY.tsv - real-world first-name frequency, the denominator for check-names.py
# tier A = SSA national top 20 (Social Security Administration, births 1926-2025)
# tier B = Nameberry top 100 girls + top 100 boys, 2025 (pageview-derived)
# A is a FAIL, B is a WARN. See NAME_FREQUENCY.md for why B is not a failure:
# a popular name is only a defect when it is anachronistic for the character, and a
# gate cannot know when a character was born. The author rules on B.
# This file is read offline and is itself frozen, so a gate result is attributable to a
# fixed list rather than to whatever a website served on the day of the run.
# Provenance and the reasoning above: calibration/NAME_FREQUENCY.md
